en: The postcard shows a black‑and‑white photograph of a large Romanesque Revival cathedral with multiple towers and a richly decorated façade featuring arcades and statues. In front of the building there is a garden with benches and people sitting. The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard layout with printed Hungarian text indicating the subject and publisher, plus a printed price in forints.
